name: Rachenahalli
tagline: A lake neighbourhood beside a major work district.
description: Rachenahalli combines a recognised lake landscape with residential communities in the northern employment belt. Its relationship with Manyata Business Park makes the exact workplace gate an important route-check destination. The lake, railway-side roads and individual project approaches create different local experiences within the same search area.
